ci_support_linux_64_python3.12.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.12.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: pywavelets
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.10.0"

package:
  name: pywavelets
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pywavelets/pywavelets-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f3cb8640225a8f3fdcbc3f6f3bd112c78927c9407cbfa65a5ff303990a6a3e32

build:
  number: 0
  skip: match(python, "<3.12")
  script:
    - mkdir builddir
    - if: unix
      then: ${{ PYTHON }} -m mesonbuild.mesonmain setup $MESON_ARGS builddir
      else: ${{ PYTHON }} -m mesonbuild.mesonmain setup %MESON_ARGS% builddir
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m build --wheel --no-isolation --skip-dependency-check -Cbuilddir=builddir
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install --find-links dist pywavelets


requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython >=3.0.4
        - numpy
        - if: unix
          then: ninja
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - cython >=3.2.5
    - meson-python >=0.18.0
    - numpy >=2.0.0
    - pip
    - python-build
  run:
    - python
    - numpy >=1.26.4,<3

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pywt
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
    script:
      - pytest --pyargs pywt

about:
  summary: PyWavelets, wavelet transform module
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/PyWavelets/
  documentation: https://pythonhosted.org/PyWavelets/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - grlee77
    - jakirkham
    - ocefpaf
    - rgommers
